candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release
method: Exact GLTFLoader; all exported skin vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils clone; actual src/game/enemy-animation.ts. Rotation-only joints are checked as fixed local pivots; the hips bob and lunge, the feet lift about a sole pivot, and the pupils and brows move by design. Feet rest on the floor. No physical-device or universal triangle-collision proof.
note: glTF axes: +Y up, character faces -Z; anatomical left is -X. Root at the floor origin under the stalk centre; feet rest on the floor.
